card.profile: Worship dance or liturgical dance take on several forms of sacred dance in Christianity and Messianic Judaism, and is usually incorporated into liturgies or worship services. It has encountered controversy and even condemnations from church officials however.
card.insight: Liturgy can only attract people when it looks, not at itself, but at God, when it allows Him to enter and act.
sources: Source: Worship dance on Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0. Read: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Worship_dance
card.sacred_note: The dance is considered a form of sacred or liturgical expression. Outsiders should be aware that it is a subject of theological debate and is not accepted in all Christian denominations or rites.
